tools_desc.Installation Guide: Automatic installation script for gno.land test13 node setup with guided menus for all node operations.

tools_desc.Telegram Bot: Telegram helper bot for GNO Test13 validators. Features: network status, live peers, active and candidate validator overviews, validator lookup, personal watchlist, missed-signature alerts with configurable thresholds and cooldowns, public RPC status, network distribution by region/country/ASN, and guides and snapshots in RU/ENG.

tools_desc.Register Validator: UI to register a new validator or edit profile (moniker, description, server type) directly from the explorer.

tools_desc.Validator Bot: Telegram bot for real-time missed block alerts on Gnoland test13. Track one or multiple active set validators with instant notifications and easy management via bot commands or dashboard quick buttons.

tools_desc.Enchanted Tenderduty: Forked and extended Tenderduty monitor with native gno.land support, allowing simultaneous monitoring of Cosmos and Gnoland nodes from a single binary. Adds Pushover as an alert sink for Do Not Disturb-bypassing mobile alerts.

tools_desc.Alarm Bot: Telegram bot for Gnoland test13 validator alerts and monitoring notifications.

tools_desc.GnoPulse Explorer: Block explorer for gno.land test13 built for both developers and end users.

tools_desc.Valley of Gnoland: Interactive terminal tool to deploy and manage a Gno.land Test13 full node and validator-candidate workflow. Covers node deployment, gnokey management, consensus pubkey, valoper registration, peer config, and node backup.

tools_desc.GnoDuty: Real-time Gno.land (TM2) validator monitor, hard fork of Tenderduty adapted for Gnoland. Includes fix for false jailed alerts caused by RPC timeouts: preserves previous bonded state on query failure instead of resetting to false.

tools_desc.Spectra Explorer: Block explorer for Gnoland test13 with transaction history, daily active users, fee charts, validator data, realm inspection, and wallet support.
tools_desc.Spectra Gnoland Indexer: Open source indexer for Gnoland, available for developers building explorers or data applications on top of the network.
tools_desc.Spectra Assets: Repository of validator logos and metadata for Gnoland, open for pull requests from validators wanting to add or update their profile assets.

tools_desc.GnoNym: UI for gno.land's official name registry (r/sys/namereg/v1). Live on-chain availability check, one-click registration via Adena, profile editor for DisplayName/Bio/Homepage/Avatar, and name-to-address resolver.

tools_desc.Live Peers: Peer scoring tool to help find high-quality peers for reliable connections, alongside block counts, transaction data, and validator uptime tracking.

tools_desc.Cumulo Live Peers: A live peer checker, updated every 30 minutes and available through both a public dashboard and API.
tools_desc.Monitoring: Grafana monitoring dashboard for Gnoland test13 validators and full nodes, providing real-time visibility into consensus health, VM execution, gas usage, mempool and P2P connectivity across 14 metric areas sourced from the OpenTelemetry endpoint
